# Mohammed Mostafa (elrefai99) — Software Engineer

> Portfolio of Mohammed Mostafa (also known as Elrefai / elrefai99), a Software
> Engineer based in Cairo, Egypt. Backend engineering: Node.js, TypeScript,
> Express.js, payment integrations (PayMob, Amazon Payment Services, Stripe),
> real-time systems (WebSockets, SSE, CRDTs/Yjs), MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis,
> BullMQ, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Software Engineer II at Lesoll (https://lesoll.com), building production
marketplace and booking platforms. Builds and operates payment systems,
background job processing, and real-time notification infrastructure.
